entries.dialogueText: Without missing a beat, another attendant presented a tattered piece of cloth elegantly displayed in a glass case. It showed both the Azaro sigil and the bull of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I present to you this flag, raised..."
entries.dialogueText: "I present to you this flag, raised in celebration after House Azaro reclaimed Montaklar during the 1926 Uprising.”

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: "“It was also carried amidst protest..."
entries.dialogueText: “It was also carried amidst protests, parades, and rallies, symbolizing our house's support for the monarchy even during the most turbulent of times.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“The flag of a proud victory! It al..."
entries.dialogueText: “The flag of a proud victory! It almost makes me want to celebrate all over again.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Interesting. I was expecting somet..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Thank you. It means a lot that you..."

entries.dialogueText: “It's a beautiful gesture, General. Look, the bloodstains on it even match the garnets on my bracelet."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m glad everyone could make it.""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Happy birthday, Mother. And to man..."

entries.title: Narrator: "After taking a moment to let the gu..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A moment, if I may.""

entries.dialogueText: The guests applauded loudly. Next to me, Mother brought a hand to her chest.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've outdone yourself, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "You've outdone yourself, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What can I say? It’s not every day..."
entries.dialogueText: "What can I say? It’s not every day we celebrate the Queen Mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had a feeling you'd like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I had a feeling you'd like it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I aim to impress.""
entries.dialogueText: "I aim to impress."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe it's come to this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe it's come to this, but we must do what must be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This will be a night to remember.""
entries.dialogueText: "This will be a night to remember."

entries.dialogueText: "Joking aside, the passing years have only added to your grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s a birthday, not a funeral.""
entries.dialogueText: "It’s a birthday, not a funeral."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Not for much longer. Every birthda..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not for much longer. Every birthday just reminds me I'm inching closer to death."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The most important thing I did for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most important thing I did for this family was give birth to you. From there on out, I've just been inching towards death."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: "“The renovations turned out even be..."
entries.dialogueText: “The renovations turned out even better than I expected. Have you seen the Old Rezenid section?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: "“It’s quite something, isn’t it, Ax..."
entries.dialogueText: “It’s quite something, isn’t it, Axel? Did you see the Old Palesian section?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: "“I love what they've done with the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I love what they've done with the place. It looks absolutely beautiful."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: "“I think the renovations breathe ne..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think the renovations breathe new life into the space. Don't you, Grandmother?”

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: "“It's great. Although I'm sure your..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's great. Although I'm sure your father would prefer it was incorporated into the Rizian section."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: "“If you like wasting money on usele..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you like wasting money on useless dust magnets. Sure, it’s fantastic.”

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Must you always find a way to ruin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Must you always find a way to ruin the mood?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's debatable.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's debatable."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You’ll have to try harder than fla..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’ll have to try harder than flattery."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter ran her hand over one o..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter ran her hand over one of the many long rows of books. Her face was rapt.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your attention, please. King Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your attention, please. King Romus speaking."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you're suffering from morning s..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're suffering from morning sickness, try a sip of gin right after you wake. It worked wonders for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They emerged from a long row of boo..."
entries.dialogueText: They emerged from a long row of books, deep in conversation.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I see they have 'Diary of a Handma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see they have 'Diary of a Handmaiden'. You know, Rizia banned that novel for decades because it dared to depict a relationship between two female servants."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Sounds far too spicy for my old bl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds far too spicy for my old blood. Those maidens should've kept keep their hands to themselves."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Aha, so that's why His Majesty tur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aha, so that's why His Majesty turned out the way he did."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both women laughed."
entries.dialogueText: Both women laughed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The atmosphere in the library shift..."
entries.dialogueText: The atmosphere in the library shifted as Lucita strode in, her elegant gown tailored with sharp lines and adorned with subtle military accents.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone looked around uncomfortabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone looked around uncomfortably, so I moved on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pulled away the cloth. Mother sto..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled away the cloth. Mother stood bathed in radiant light, her figure illuminated with an unearthly glow.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've certainly put in a lot of e..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've certainly put in a lot of effort, Romus. It’s... quite something."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother's eyes lingered on the paint..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother's eyes lingered on the painting with a hint of hesitation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I revealed the portrait of Mother,..."
entries.dialogueText: I revealed the portrait of Mother, standing at the heart of a public square surrounded by commoners.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""For Dast's sake. Is this really wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "For Dast's sake. Is this really what I look like?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother's eyes narrowed as she scrut..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother's eyes narrowed as she scrutinized the gift.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel fell silent. Mother continued..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel fell silent. Mother continued to survey the renovations, looking unimpressed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's good to know. Keep up the g..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's good to know. Keep up the good work.”

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Yes, of course. I didn't mean to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course. I didn't mean to imply otherwise."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Understood, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s my will that keeps everyone i..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s my will that keeps everyone in line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“As long as they’re not bothering m..."
entries.dialogueText: “As long as they’re not bothering me, I suppose that’s all that matters."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Absolutely, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I hope your subjects like it, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope your subjects like it, then."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""No, no... it'll just take some get..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, no... it'll just take some getting used to."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Yes, this certainly is special.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, this certainly is special."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I appreciate the effort. I really..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the effort. I really do."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Thank you. The last thing we want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. The last thing we want is for our fellow nobles to see me as a frail old lush."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s not easy to find something th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s not easy to find something that captures all you are, you know. I thought this was a worthy attempt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't only a gift to you. It'..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't only a gift to you. It's for all of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A special portrait for a special s..."
entries.dialogueText: "A special portrait for a special someone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, of course not. I'll send it ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course not. I'll send it back to the painter for corrections at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, it's uncanny. The ultimate en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's uncanny. The ultimate encapsulation of your grace and beauty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How honestly do you want me to ans..."
entries.dialogueText: "How honestly do you want me to answer?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You hate it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You hate it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus wheeled his chair o..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus wheeled his chair over next to her, his finest uniform decorated with medals.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beside him, General Carlos Azaro, c..."
entries.dialogueText: Beside him, General Carlos Azaro, commander of the Rizian Armed Forces, stepped in, clad in standard utilitarian military garb.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, it’s an honor to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, it’s an honor to be here. May this year bring you continued health and happiness."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Of course, Your Majesty. My apolog..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. My apologies for bringing it up. We're here to celebrate, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won’t subject you to a lengthy s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won’t subject you to a lengthy speech -- just a simple show of appreciation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To Queen Mother Estela Toras, prot..."
entries.dialogueText: "To Queen Mother Estela Toras, protector of the Toras dynasty and matriarch of the realm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May this portrait hang in the libr..."
entries.dialogueText: "May this portrait hang in the library forever, reminding visitors of its legendary namesake."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must commend each of you for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must commend each of you for the thoughtful gifts, but I daresay none of them will hold a candle to what I have in store."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Drumroll, please...""
entries.dialogueText: "Drumroll, please..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our guests applauded politely."
entries.dialogueText: Our guests applauded politely.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, I think it's ridiculous. But o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I think it's ridiculous. But our house will eat it up."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And my crow's feet. You're mercile..."
entries.dialogueText: "And my crow's feet. You're merciless, Romus."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Come on, darling. I know that's no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, darling. I know that's not this portrait's real purpose."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Well, you've hit your mark. Our ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, you've hit your mark. Our house will love this."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I assure you much thought was put..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you much thought was put into this. By everyone in House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will celebrate tonight.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will celebrate tonight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tension often comes from unexpecte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tension often comes from unexpected places. It’s fascinating how quickly things can shift, especially when guided by unseen hands."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Yes... it's unsettling to think so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... it's unsettling to think something might be stirring beneath the surface."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I caught Hubertus and Hugo exchangi..."
entries.dialogueText: I caught Hubertus and Hugo exchanging a quick, uncertain glance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your assistance to Vina is deeply..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your assistance to Vina is deeply appreciated.”

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to hear. Yet some might say t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to hear. Yet some might say that the kingdom thrives best when its citizens feel they have a greater hand in shaping the path forward."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus and Hugo exchanged a quick..."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus and Hugo exchanged a quick, uncertain glance.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""A compelling thought, but there’s..."
entries.dialogueText: "A compelling thought, but there’s something to be said for the tradition that has kept us strong so far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When people call for change, it’s..."
entries.dialogueText: "When people call for change, it’s often because they feel unheard. Perhaps we could help them feel more involved in shaping their future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus and Hugo exchanged a quick..."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus and Hugo exchanged a quick, uncertain glance.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""That may be true, Your Majesty, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be true, Your Majesty, but there’s always a risk in giving up too much control. Stability often depends on decisive leadership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That victory was only earned by ig..."
entries.dialogueText: "That victory was only earned by ignoring the voice of the people. A mistake that will never happen again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus hesitated, his brow furrowi..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus hesitated, his brow furrowing as he searched for the right words.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, had we not fought th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, had we not fought the uprising, the people would have killed every last Azaro and Toras alike."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You may not like the way we won, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not like the way we won, but it is the reason any of us are here today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Gold and diamonds? Since when does..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gold and diamonds? Since when does House Sazon hold such high regard for material wealth?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was met by curious glances."
entries.dialogueText: I was met by curious glances.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Brenas has a long tradition of art..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brenas has a long tradition of artisanry. This comes from one of our most esteemed jewelers."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And it is most appreciated. Isn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it is most appreciated. Isn't it, Romus?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In one hand, she held a pair of sca..."
entries.dialogueText: In one hand, she held a pair of scales, In the other was a flower, which she was handing to a child in the crowd. White doves hovered above her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I unveiled the painting of Mother...."
entries.dialogueText: I unveiled the painting of Mother. She was holding court at a party, a cocktail in one hand and a cigarette in the other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The painter had perfectly captured..."
entries.dialogueText: The painter had perfectly captured her likeness, down to the last wrinkle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In one hand, she held the scripture..."
entries.dialogueText: In one hand, she held the scriptures of St. Wruhec aloft.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In her other arm, she cradled a nur..."
entries.dialogueText: In her other arm, she cradled a nursing baby with a halo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pulled away the cloth.  Mother st..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled away the cloth.  Mother stood tall, gripping a sword, her figure framed by the remnants of a triumphant battlefield.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Banners fluttered in victory, while..."
entries.dialogueText: Banners fluttered in victory, while fallen enemies laid behind her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my seat at the head of the t..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my seat at the head of the table. The servers began bringing out tray after tray of delicacies: stuffed wild mushrooms from Cardesse-Montaklar, roast boar from Brenas, and of course Toras flambé with succulent Monqiz lobster.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Get-out indeed, Mr. Montoro. I was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get-out indeed, Mr. Montoro. I was under the impression that this gathering was exclusively for nobles."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Luckily for all of us, my reputati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Luckily for all of us, my reputation is one of nobility by proxy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't press your luck, Rusty. Nobi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't press your luck, Rusty. Nobility is earned through lineage and service, *not* reputation."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And what have I provided to you, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what have I provided to you, if not service?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Montoro has done more for Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro has done more for Rizia than many of us in this room."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Anyway, I brought a little somethi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway, I brought a little something. Hope you like it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He unceremoniously ripped off the p..."
entries.dialogueText: He unceremoniously ripped off the paper that was covering the rectangle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Montoro has come here to celeb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro has come here to celebrate your birthday. Please, be civil to him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just pretend like he's not even he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just pretend like he's not even here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Dissatisfaction among the guests wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Dissatisfaction among the guests was evident as they whispered to one another.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now, now. This isn't a competition.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now, now. This isn't a competition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that the sound of class..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that the sound of classical Rizian music filled the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A slow series of claps resonated fr..."
entries.dialogueText: A slow series of claps resonated from behind the group.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All eyes shifted to the library ent..."
entries.dialogueText: All eyes shifted to the library entrance, where Rusty Montoro stood, smirking. A large, wrapped rectangular object rested against the wall next to him.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""It's breathtaking, Your Majesty! W..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's breathtaking, Your Majesty! Wish I'd thought of it myself."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Happy birthday, Queen Mother Estel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Happy birthday, Queen Mother Estela. You must be proud as all get-out to have such a devoted son."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I will after I see what he's broug..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will after I see what he's brought me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty let out a loud, exaggerated l..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty let out a loud, exaggerated laugh.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's the spirit. I hope you like..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit. I hope you like it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I will behave as I damn well pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will behave as I damn well please -- birthday or no birthday."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I couldn't agree more, Your Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree more, Your Royal Highness!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus squeezed her hand."
entries.dialogueText: Manus squeezed her hand.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Tonight's about the guests, love...."
entries.dialogueText: "Tonight's about the guests, love. You'll get another chance to go through the books."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The blare of a megaphone suddenly s..."
entries.dialogueText: The blare of a megaphone suddenly sounded outside the window. A policeman was warning the protesters to stay back.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""...Or so I hope.""
entries.dialogueText: "...Or so I hope."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita pulled a volume off the shel..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita pulled a volume off the shelf and hefted it in her hand. Its gold-plated spine read 'Encyclopedia Rizania 1894'.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't know why they keep these o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know why they keep these out-of-date reference books around, unless it's to serve as a projectile."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel had pulled one of the volumes..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel had pulled one of the volumes off the shelf and was perusing it closely.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""'Diary of a Handmaiden'. You know,..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Diary of a Handmaiden'. You know, this novel was banned for decades because it dared to depict an intimate relationship between two female servants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina looked from Pabel to me. She s..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina looked from Pabel to me. She smiled sympathetically.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thankfully, those days are over.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, those days are over."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart threw me a wink."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart threw me a wink.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""This again. I was hoping for a qui..."
entries.dialogueText: "This again. I was hoping for a quiet visit for once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to see Mother and Vina."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to see Mother and Vina.

entries.dialogueText: I turned to see my mother, along with Vina and her husband.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Honestly, Madam Estela, I'm comple..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, Madam Estela, I'm completely fine. More than that. I feel like I could take on anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She caught my eye and gave me a kno..."
entries.dialogueText: She caught my eye and gave me a knowing smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother continued to survey the reno..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother continued to survey the renovations, looking unimpressed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother surveyed her surroundings, l..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother surveyed her surroundings, looking unimpressed.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I should be out there helping keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should be out there helping keep the peace. Not here wasting my time among antiques."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If you haven't noticed, there's a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you haven't noticed, there's a riot going on. The nobility should be organizing a response, not wasting our time among antiques."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Forgive me, my lady wife, but I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, my lady wife, but I've got better things to do than waste my time among antiques."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the effort, Romus, but the last thing I want is to be remembered as an aging lush for all eternity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amid the guests at the table, polit..."
entries.dialogueText: Amid the guests at the table, polite applause alternated with concerned whispers.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And I couldn't well refuse an invi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I couldn't well refuse an invitation from His Majesty, could I?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He too had brought a painting -- a..."
entries.dialogueText: He too had brought a painting -- a hilly, sun-dappled landscape filled with row upon row of leafy green plants.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I see. What a lovely scene.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see. What a lovely scene."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You like it? It's yours. And I don..."
entries.dialogueText: "You like it? It's yours. And I don't mean the painting."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're looking at the Estela Barto..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're looking at the Estela Bartos Toras Royal Reserve, the finest tobacco farm in all of Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grinned."
entries.dialogueText: He grinned.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yeah. When RRG got back our old si..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah. When RRG got back our old sites in Zille, a bunch of them were all mined out -- but ripe for rehabilitation as farmland."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yeah. Took advantage of the mess i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah. Took advantage of the mess in Zille to get back some of RRG's old land there. It was all mined out -- but ripe for rehabilitation as farmland."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yeah. Turns out a few folks in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah. Turns out a few folks in the area still want to do business with Rizians. Managed to get back a patch of old RRG land that's all mined out -- but perfect for farming."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He tossed my mother a cigarette pac..."
entries.dialogueText: He tossed my mother a cigarette packet.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Nothing you need to be concerned a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing you need to be concerned about."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We've barricaded off the entirety..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've barricaded off the entirety of the square. A number of rioters have been pushing to get through, but the police and Wruhec's Guardians are successfully holding them back."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We've barricaded off the entirety..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've barricaded off the entirety of the square. A number of rioters have been pushing to get through, but the police and my men are successfully holding them back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I expect no disruptions toni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I expect no disruptions tonight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them not to use force. We can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell them not to use force. We can't have accusations of police brutality overshadowing tonight's events."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll relay your instructions. Thou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll relay your instructions. Though if more protesters join the fray, it may be impossible to stop them from getting through."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dammit. Couldn't they have chosen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dammit. Couldn't they have chosen any other night?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I suspect the high-profile nature..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect the high-profile nature of tonight's occasion is exactly why they're targeting it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've given word to Wruhec's Guardi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've given word to Wruhec's Guardians. They're on standby awaiting our signal."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've given word to my most trusted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've given word to my most trusted guardsmen. They're on standby awaiting our signal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Outside the library windows, the an..."
entries.dialogueText: Outside the library windows, the angry shouts of protesters could be heard.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My guardsmen are in contact with M..."
entries.dialogueText: "My guardsmen are in contact with Mr. Montoro's forces. They should be on standby, awaiting your signal."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My guardsmen are in contact with D..."
entries.dialogueText: "My guardsmen are in contact with Duchess Azaro's unit. They should be on standby, awaiting your signal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And our friends out there? I assum..."
entries.dialogueText: "And our friends out there? I assume they won't be a problem?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus shook his head forcefully."
entries.dialogueText: Titus shook his head forcefully.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Everything’s secure, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “Everything’s secure, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stood nearby, his voice close..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stood nearby, his voice close enough that only I could hear.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I took the liberty of conducting a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took the liberty of conducting a background check on the new catering staff. It all came back clean."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Our guards are in place, just as I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our guards are in place, just as I showed you. Nobody's getting in here on my watch."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Due to all the high-profile names..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to all the high-profile names on tonight's guest list, I took the liberty of doubling up on our usual number of guards."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to go overboard on securit..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to go overboard on security measures. We nobles can take care of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Everything will go as planned. Lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything will go as planned. Leave it to us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're paranoid, Titus. Nobody's p..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're paranoid, Titus. Nobody's planning any attacks on the library."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good work, Captain Gordion. I hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good work, Captain Gordion. I hope you can take some time to relax and enjoy the evening yourself."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not my primary objective, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not my primary objective, Your Majesty, but thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get to your post. The guests will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get to your post. The guests will be arriving any minute now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Given the current climate, one can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the current climate, one can't be too careful."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I know that, Your Majesty, but one..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that, Your Majesty, but one can't be too careful."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Forgive me, my lady wife, but your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, my lady wife, but your ex-paramour ruined the mood before we even showed up."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Do us all a favor, will you, deare..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do us all a favor, will you, dearest Ricardus? Grow up."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Do not take the Lord's name in vai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not take the Lord's name in vain, Queen Mother."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal walked over to take his place a..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal walked over to take his place alongside us.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Forgive me, Grand Wiseman. I didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Grand Wiseman. I didn't realize our new government forbids praying for a cigarette."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's all right, Grandmother. We al..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all right, Grandmother. We all need time to get used to the coming changes."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You'll get used to the changes, Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll get used to the changes, Madam Estela. It's not that much of a difference."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina cast a sidelong glance at me."
entries.dialogueText: Vina cast a sidelong glance at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is the first big gathering si..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the first big gathering since I announced the transformation of Rizia. I do expect everyone to be on their best behavior."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother deserves a special dispe..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother deserves a special dispensation on her birthday, Sal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tobacco is a vice anyway, Mother...."
entries.dialogueText: "Tobacco is a vice anyway, Mother. Nobody who smokes can reach Golconda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quiet, everyone. It's time to open..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, everyone. It's time to open the doors."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, son. For everything I did befo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, son. For everything I did before I met your father, Golconda's far out of reach for me anyway."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes, very well. You are forgiven,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, very well. You are forgiven, madam."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone around me nodded hurriedly..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone around me nodded hurriedly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he approached, the general offer..."
entries.dialogueText: As he approached, the general offered a sharp salute, followed by a deep bow to my mother.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two Azaros offered a sharp salu..."
entries.dialogueText: The two Azaros offered a sharp salute, followed by a deep bow to my mother.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I thought this was what the King w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought this was what the King wanted. We're all equals today, right?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I thought this was what the King w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought this was what the King wanted. We're all equals before the Lord, right?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke in jovial tones, but the s..."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke in jovial tones, but the sarcasm was palpable. Taddeus gave him a look of warning.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Forgive me. I forgot that style sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me. I forgot that style should always take precedence over troop preparedness."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please excuse my cousin, Madam Est..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please excuse my cousin, Madam Estela. And accept this gift as a token of House Azaro's appreciation."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Duke Reinhart, Your Grace. If I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart, Your Grace. If I'd known it would be this easy to get Pales to rejoin Rizia, I would have married you myself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Lucita embraced."
entries.dialogueText: He and Lucita embraced.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I can't believe you've finally set..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe you've finally settled down, Lucy. Or should I say settled *up*?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave him a playful shove."
entries.dialogueText: She gave him a playful shove.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's Queen Consort Lucita Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's Queen Consort Lucita Toras to you, Carlito."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please excuse my cousin, Madam Est..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please excuse my cousin, Madam Estela. And accept this gift as a token of House Azaro's appreciation."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We've brought a gift for the Queen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've brought a gift for the Queen Mother. A small token of House Azaro's appreciation."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""With all three of Rizia's royal ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all three of Rizia's royal houses in one place, it might yet turn into one."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""General Carlos sends his regards...."
entries.dialogueText: "General Carlos sends his regards. He's handling operations in Pales while I'm here."

entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo bowed to Sal."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo bowed to Sal.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Grand Wiseman. I am looking forwar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Wiseman. I am looking forward to assisting you with Rizia's transition."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Very kind of you, Your Grace, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very kind of you, Your Grace, but I already have access to all the documents I need."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Very kind of you, Your Grace. It i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very kind of you, Your Grace. It is the mark of a truly great Grand Vizier that he knows when to step aside."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well... good. Do let me know if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... good. Do let me know if you have questions."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's just as well he's not here. M..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's just as well he's not here. My cousin is a terrible dresser."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and her father embraced."
entries.dialogueText: She and her father embraced.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My only hope is that my grandson w..."
entries.dialogueText: "My only hope is that my grandson will be born in a Rizia that is finally at peace."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father. We still don't know whethe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. We still don't know whether it's a boy."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Right. In any case, Madam Estela,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. In any case, Madam Estela, please accept this gift as a token of House Azaro's appreciation."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Considering all he has done for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Considering all he has done for this kingdom, I think he can be excused."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""In the meantime, Madam Estela, ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, Madam Estela, please accept this gift as a token of House Azaro's appreciation."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""As am I. I've heard nothing but go..."
entries.dialogueText: "As am I. I've heard nothing but good things about you."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Yes, it's always *such* a pleasure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's always *such* a pleasure to welcome members of Rizia's most loyal and trusted house."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Ahem. Thank you, Your Highness.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ahem. Thank you, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the Sazons departed, I was gr..."
entries.dialogueText: After the Sazons departed, I was greeted by a cavalcade of nobles from the lesser houses, including Daria de Rava.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The only commoner invited was Rusty..."
entries.dialogueText: The only commoner invited was Rusty Montoro. I looked around, but there was no sign of him.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We no longer have to deal with Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We no longer have to deal with Wehlen to get Wehzek tobacco. Look for these babies in every pharmacy in the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Thanks to our import deal with Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to our import deal with Wehlen, you'll soon find these babies in every pharmacy in the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We can't import these just yet. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't import these just yet. But I'm working on it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother applauded gleefully."
entries.dialogueText: My mother applauded gleefully.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Bravo, Mr. Montoro. You've earned..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bravo, Mr. Montoro. You've earned yourself a seat at this table."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, thank you, Rusty. What an une..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank you, Rusty. What an unexpectedly thoughtful gift."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wheeling and dealing with foreign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wheeling and dealing with foreign governments behind my back is your idea of a present?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Be honest, Rusty. Was your intenti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be honest, Rusty. Was your intention to celebrate the Queen Mother's birthday or diversify your own personal holdings?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Can't it be both?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't it be both?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And where are the King's cigarette..."
entries.dialogueText: "And where are the King's cigarettes, pray tell?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""No worries. I've brought more than..."
entries.dialogueText: "No worries. I've brought more than enough to go round."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Unexpected? You wound me. I think..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unexpected? You wound me. I think of you and the Royal Family all the time."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""It's called normalizing relations...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's called normalizing relations. I thought you'd like it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty caught my eye and threw me a..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty caught my eye and threw me a wink.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Those are peaceful protesters, not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those are peaceful protesters, not rioters. As long as they don't enter the library, they should be free to demonstrate where they want."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Understood, Your Majesty. I'll rel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty. I'll relay your instructions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shouting in the background sudd..."
entries.dialogueText: The shouting in the background suddenly increased in volume. It sounded as if the protesters were right outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The blare of a megaphone suddenly s..."
entries.dialogueText: The blare of a megaphone suddenly sounded outside the window. A policeman was warning the protesters to stay back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shouting in the background sudd..."
entries.dialogueText: The shouting in the background suddenly increased in volume. It sounded as if the protesters were right outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The blare of a megaphone suddenly s..."
entries.dialogueText: The blare of a megaphone suddenly sounded outside the window. A policeman was warning the protesters to stay back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shouting in the background sudd..."
entries.dialogueText: The shouting in the background suddenly increased in volume. It sounded as if the protesters were right outside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's going on out there?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's going on out there?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe they're still at i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe they're still at it. After everything I've done for them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, the adoring cries of my faithf..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the adoring cries of my faithful subjects. I feel so soothed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Don't worry about them.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The commoners' ingratitude is appa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The commoners' ingratitude is appalling indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe they're still at i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe they're still at it. Haven't they learned their lesson yet?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Apparently not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't the Golden Guard deal with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't the Golden Guard deal with that ruckus?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We're trying our best.""
entries.dialogueText: "We're trying our best."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As your security councilor, I'd ad..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your security councilor, I'd advise we come up with a long-term plan to deal with these protests."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If I may ask, Your Majesty... what..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may ask, Your Majesty... what does the Crown plan on doing about these protests in the long term?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a plan, Titus. Place your t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a plan, Titus. Place your trust in your King, and all will be well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tonight, I plan to ask the royal h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tonight, I plan to ask the royal houses to come to my aid. With the entirety of the Rizian nobility working together, we can bring peace to the kingdom once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've tried everything, Captain. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've tried everything, Captain. I have no clue how to stop them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""An excellent idea. I wish you luck..."
entries.dialogueText: "An excellent idea. I wish you luck with it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I do trust you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do trust you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Golden Guard is here to assist..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golden Guard is here to assist you, should you need us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These ingrates have gone against t..."
entries.dialogueText: "These ingrates have gone against their king, and they will be punished. All of them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Titus frowned.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The movement is spreading quickly,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The movement is spreading quickly, Your Majesty. I'm worried it can no longer be suppressed."
